repos.name: hoocode-ts
repos.description: Deterministic terminal coding agent with four scoped modes (Ask, Plan, Build, Debug), 25+ providers, hybrid search, and one-click plugins in a single binary. Published to npm as @kolisachint/hoocode-agent.
repos.readme:
HooCode is a deterministic terminal coding agent — four scoped modes (Ask · Plan · Build · Debug), 25+ providers, hybrid search, and one-click plugins in a single binary. Nothing applies without your approval.

The one-click installers need no root, install into ~/.hoocode, and pre-seed the optional Rust helpers (fd, rg, embsearch, webtools, voicetools) so your first session is fast even offline. Full details, including the standalone archives and container setups, are in…

repos.name: embeddingsearchtools
repos.description: Semantic search in Rust. MiniLM through ONNX Runtime with int8 weights bundled in-binary, HNSW approximate nearest neighbour written from scratch, BM25 fusion for hybrid retrieval, mmap-backed store. Library, CLI and daemon.
repos.readme:
Semantic search in Rust, built from the primitives rather than assembled out of services: HNSW written from scratch, BM25 fused on top of the vectors, and an int8 MiniLM bundled inside the binary through ONNX Runtime. No Python, no vector database, no network call — an mmap-backed store behind a library API, a CLI, and a long-lived stdio daemon.

Design · Performance · CLI · Daemon protocol

repos.name: voicetools
repos.description: Offline speech recognition in Rust. Microphone to VAD to Parakeet-TDT on ONNX Runtime, 25 languages, whisper.cpp fallback. No audio leaves the machine.
repos.readme:
Local, offline voice-to-text for the terminal. A small Rust binary that captures your microphone, stops automatically when you go quiet, and streams recognized text on stdout using a simple line protocol — designed to drop into a TUI (e.g. hoocode) as a push-to-talk input. No audio ever leaves the machine.

Install · Output protocol · Architecture · Status

repos.name: webtools
repos.description: Token-efficient web fetch and search for LLM agents. Preserves reference-style URLs as single-token markers so a page fits inside a context budget.
repos.readme:
A unified, token-efficient web fetch + search CLI for LLM agents, built around reference-style URL preservation. One small, fast binary that works with no API keys and no backend — and takes them when you want better search.

Links become inline [N] markers with the full URLs collected into a trailing reference block — the agent sees [1] (≈1 token) but can still recover the exact URL. --max-tokens caps the whole output, references included.
